title: feat(bash): support to set cwd in the `Bash` tool
body:
**Background**

The `Bash` tool currently does not support setting a current working directory (cwd), which limits its ability to integrate seamlessly with the workspace.

**Changes**
- Add a `cwd` argument to the constructor of the Bash class, allowing the working directory to be configured at initialization.
